steps.body: A take-away can be acted out too: children stop playing and go home, one at a time.
steps.narration: A take-away can be acted out too: children stop playing and go home, one at a time.

widget.prompt: 6 children are playing. 2 go home. Hop back to show how many still play.

commonLandings.feedback: That never moved. Two children left, so fewer are playing.
That counts the children who went home, not the ones still playing.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 6 and count back 2: you land on 4.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 4 — 6 children with 2 gone leaves 4.

steps.body: Choose the action for a new take-away story.
explanationVariants: Ducks flying away make the pond group smaller, so subtract the leaving group.
The setting changes from a playground to a pond, but the take-away action still transfers.

widget.prompt: 9 ducks swim in a pond. Then 5 ducks fly away. Which action finds how many ducks stay?

options.label: Subtract the leaving group
options.feedback: Yes. The 5 ducks leave the group of 9, so subtraction finds which ducks stay.

options.label: Add the leaving group
options.feedback: Adding would make the pond group larger, but 5 ducks fly away from it.

options.label: Count the leaving group only
options.feedback: That finds how many ducks fly away, not how many ducks stay in the pond.

hints: Watch what happens to the pond group.
Five ducks leave, so the group gets smaller.
Choose subtraction for a shrinking group.
